---
title: "Usage"
---

## Commands

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| `mypackage init` | Create a configuration file |
| `mypackage run` | Run the main task |
| `mypackage status` | Show what has been done so far |

## From Python

```{.python filename="example.py"}
import mypackage

result = mypackage.run("data/example.csv")
print(result.summary())
```

::: {.callout-warning}
Note anything that can surprise users, such as rate limits or long run times.
:::
